newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy used car market shows slight upturn -report.
newsitem.headline: Italy used car market shows slight upturn -report.

text.p: Italy's used car market is continuing to show a slight improvement after first signs of an upturn emerged after the summer, auto forecasting body Centro Studi Promotor (CSP) said.
CSP said in its latest survey that at the end of October some 43 percent of dealers polled said sales volumes were unsatisfactory, against 45 percent polled at end-September.
Dealers declaring high stock levels came down to 46 percent from 49 percent, CSP added.
